description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Enum' for creating enum types in PHP. It includes properties and methods for managing enum values, keys, validation, comparison, and serialization.

classes.name: Enum
classes.description: An abstract base class providing enum functionality, including storing enum values and keys, validation, comparison, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the enum with a value, possibly deriving the key if the value is an existing enum instance.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Serialization hook to restore the key property after deserialization.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an enum instance from a given value.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the enum's value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another variable is equal to this enum instance based on value and class.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all constant keys of the enum class.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns all enum instances corresponding to class constants.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an associative array of constant names to their values.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a value is a valid enum value.

methods.name: assertValidValue
methods.description: Asserts whether a value is valid; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: assertValidValueReturningKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with a valid value, throws if invalid.

methods.name: isValidKey
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid enum key.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Finds the key for a given value.

methods.name: __callStatic
methods.description: Allows static method calls to instantiate enum constants by name.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the enum as its value for JSON encoding.
